# ColmarTour — Colmar Travel Guide

> An independent, fact-checked guide to visiting Colmar in Alsace, France: the painted
> old town, La Petite Venise, the Musée Unterlinden and the Christmas markets. Written
> by Eugene, a former guide who has lived in France for sixteen years. Published by
> Touringbee Limited (Ireland, reg. 660321), maker of the TouringBee self-guided audio tours.

## Key facts
- Colmar old town: free to walk. Compact enough to see in half a day.
- Musée Unterlinden (Isenheim Altarpiece): EUR 14, Wed-Mon 09:00-18:00, closed Tuesdays.
- Musée Bartholdi (birthplace of the Statue of Liberty's sculptor): Tue-Sun 10:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00, closed Mondays.
- Christmas markets 2026: 23 November - 29 December, six separate markets.
- Rail: Paris Gare de l'Est ~2h20 (TGV) · Strasbourg ~30 min · Basel ~45 min.
- TouringBee Colmar audio guide: 27 stops, ~1.5 hours, offline, EUR 9.99, in English, French, German, Italian and Polish.
- Audio guide rating: 4.6/5, over 1,000 travellers, reviews on Tripadvisor and Viator.
- This site is published in 8 languages: EN (/), FR (/fr/), DE (/de/), ES (/es/), IT (/it/), PT (/pt/), PL (/pl/), RU (/ru/). The audio itself exists only in EN, FR, DE, IT, PL.

- [Visiting Colmar: the complete guide](https://colmartour.com/): the pillar guide to the town.

- [Christmas market 2026 dates and hours](https://colmartour.com/colmar-christmas-market-dates/): confirmed dates.
- [Colmar walking tour](https://colmartour.com/colmar-walking-tour/): the self-guided 27-stop route.
- [La Petite Venise](https://colmartour.com/petite-venise-colmar/): the canal quarter and the boat ride.
- [How to get to Colmar](https://colmartour.com/how-to-get-to-colmar/): train from Paris, Strasbourg and Basel.
- [The Alsace Wine Route](https://colmartour.com/alsace-wine-route/): the villages, in order, with and without a car.
- [All guides](https://colmartour.com/guides/)
